payload.title: Compare open-source alternatives to Laya for DIP task matching
payload.description: User explicitly requests checking whether other open-source models already outperform Laya on existing-task identity/partial overlap classification. Keep this distinct from the initial Laya zero-shot feasibility pilot. Evaluate compact multilingual pair encoders/rerankers and typed-decision models on the same held-out DIP domain data; no presumed quality ranking from generic leaderboards.
acceptance: Verify code/weight licenses and supported local CPU/Windows/Linux/macOS runtimes for each candidate.

Use identical bilingual inputs, candidate sets, labels and test splits to compare Laya and alternatives; report exact identity precision, false merges, missed matches, overlap classification and confidence/abstention.
Measure cold load, warm CPU latency, memory/model download size and Node integration cost alongside quality.
Include existing pretrained baselines before proposing fine-tuning; label model-specific tuning separately and retain all candidate outcomes.
